name: azure-boards
description: Azure Boards plugin with individual Microsoft Entra login or token access, Work Item operations, and explainable AI delivery and process cockpit tools.

interface.shortDescription: AI delivery and process cockpit for Azure Boards
interface.longDescription: Use Azure Boards with individual Microsoft Entra login or token access to query, create, update, and comment on Work Items, plus explainable AI tools for delivery risk, process bottlenecks, SLA aging, governance gaps, scope creep, and executive status reporting.
defaultPrompt: Show delivery risks and SLA issues in my Azure Boards project.
Improve this Work Item with clear acceptance criteria.
Find process gaps and bottlenecks across my board.
